purpose: C.9 Example 1 (flat uncapped cashback): the baseline sanity card -- one uncapped percentage rule, no caps, no thresholds, no exclusions, no fees. Confirms the pipeline produces the plainest possible correct answer (spend * rate) with nothing else in play.

assumptions.note: Grocery ticket 700 and dining ticket 600 are both even, so ticket*1.5% lands on an exact multiple of Rs0.01 (700*0.015=10.50, 600*0.015=9.00) -- zero floor loss, no rounding_estimated flag expected.

_hand_computation: Stage 2 (eligibility): no exclusions on this card -> the reward view is the full spend grid, unchanged.
Stage 3 (match): the card's only earning rule, base (selector={}), matches every segment regardless of category.

Stage 4 (accrue): percentage 1.5%, floor_paise_per_txn. Both tickets are even so ea = rate exactly, no approximation error. Annual gross = (2,40,000 + 1,20,000) * 0.015 = 3,60,000 * 0.015 = Rs5,400.00 (cashback_inr, single route, ratio 1.0, no primary_route declaration needed).
Stage 5 (cap): no caps on this card -> no-op.
Stage 6-7 (thresholds): no thresholds on this card -> threshold_events is empty, waived=False, but annual_fee=0 anyway.
Fees: joining_fee=0, annual_fee=0 -> steady_fee = 0*1.18 = Rs0.00. year1_fee = (0+0)*1.18 = Rs0.00.
NACV Year-1 = 5,400.00 - 0 (fee) = Rs5,400.00 (identical -- no fee either year).
